{{Quote|Kaliyo decided, after nearly a year of supplying me with product, to play a little shell game. I lost a considerable sum and nearly went to prison.|Yjal|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Yjal''' was a [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] arms dealer who lived during the time of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was an associate of [[Kaliyo Djannis]] and hired her to provide him with more weapons to sell. Her side deals got him in trouble and he lost a considerable fortune and almost went to [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. Following that, he began hunting her down to either force her recoup his losses or [[Death/Legends|kill]] her. To protect herself, Djannis made Yjal a target for [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] and had [[Cipher Nine]] assassinate him.

==Behind the scenes==
If the agent player chooses a light side option, he/she can avoid violence by paying Kaliyo's debt.
